'''Berenicia Morsad''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]]. She is part of the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]].

== Appearance ==
She is plump and always looks grave. She has a sharp tongue.

== Strength and Abilities ==
Berenicia is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of of {{opsl|25}}. She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a [[Traveling|gateway]] of useful size. Barring some below average ability for the Talent, she should be able to [[Traveling|Travel]].

She is the second weakest in strength among the sisters making up the [[Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn]], with only [[Valinde Nathenos]] being weaker. 

She adhered to the Aes Sedai hierarchy by deferring to more powerful sisters, but could grumble quietly even while doing so.

== History ==
Berenicia was born in {{ne|838}} in the Border Marches in [[Shienar]]. She went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|854}}. After spending eight years as a [[novice]] and six years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|868}}.

She has a [[Warder]].

== Activities ==
She is part of the [[Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn|Salidar delegation]] sent to greet [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Caemlyn]]. According to Min, she was impressed that [[Agelmar Jagad]] had once received Rand in Fal Dara. She Heals [[Demira Eriff]] when she is stabbed by false [[Aiel]]. 

After the delegation is dissolved she escorts all the [[Two Rivers]] girls wanting to become novices back to Salidar. She leaned towards Romanda's faction.

== Name Origin ==
Berenicia is derived from the first name, '''Berenice''', of Greek origin. There are several historical figures [[wikipedia:Berenice|of this name]], but no specific parallels. The Latinised version of the name is '''Veronica''' which has several alternative spellings.
